svg.title: PlaNet and Dreamer: shared latent dynamics, different ways to choose actions

text.tspan: PlaNet and Dreamer: shared latent dynamics, different ways to choose actions
A state has two parts: memory and uncertainty.
DreamerV3 · one observed step. The image corrects a prediction made from previous experience.

g.title: A state has two parts: memory and uncertainty.
g.desc: DreamerV3 · one observed step. The image corrects a prediction made from previous experience. The recurrent transition combines the previous memory, stochastic state, and action. Its new memory predicts a prior over zₜ. The encoder adds the current observation. The posterior uses that evidence and memory; its sampled zₜ joins hₜ to form the model state. Prediction heads learn observation, reward, and continuation targets. Opposite stop-gradient directions balance prior and posterior learning. DreamerV3. Categorical grids are schematic; sg denotes stop-gradient. Free-nats clipping, loss weights, layer widths, and normalization are omitted.

text.tspan: Ldyn = KL[sg(q) ‖ p] Lrep = KL[q ‖ sg(p)]

The actor learns from futures the model invents.
DreamerV3 · imagined trajectories. The same dynamics parameters are reused at each step.

g.title: The actor learns from futures the model invents.
g.desc: DreamerV3 · imagined trajectories. The same dynamics parameters are reused at each step. The actor samples an action from the current latent state. The RSSM generates the next state without a new image; the loop repeats. Reward and continuation predictions combine with critic values to produce bootstrapped λ-return targets. The actor is trained using advantage-weighted log probabilities and entropy. The critic fits return targets with slow-value regularization. The diagram follows the DreamerV3 implementation. Imagined features and the actor’s value baseline are detached. Orange inputs carry log-probabilities and entropy; purple inputs carry critic predictions. PlaNet instead searches action sequences online with CEM; it does not use this Dreamer actor-training path.

text.tspan: Deployment: observation → posterior state → actor → environment
The diagram follows the DreamerV3 implementation. Imagined features and the actor’s value baseline are detached. Orange inputs
carry log-probabilities and entropy; purple inputs carry critic predictions. PlaNet instead searches action sequences online
with CEM; it does not use this Dreamer actor-training path.
PlaNet searches at the moment an action is needed.
PlaNet · the behavior branch diverges here: online planning uses latent rollouts and predicted rewards.

g.title: PlaNet searches at the moment an action is needed.
g.desc: PlaNet · the behavior branch diverges here: online planning uses latent rollouts and predicted rewards. Infer a latent state from the current observation history. Initialize a distribution over candidate action sequences. Roll each candidate through the RSSM prior and use the reward model to score its predicted trajectory. CEM refits the action distribution to elite sequences and repeats. Execute only the first action, observe, update the posterior, and plan again. Original PlaNet uses Gaussian stochastic latents. This contrasts with the categorical DreamerV3 state shown above. The planner is CEM in a receding-horizon loop; it is not Dreamer’s actor–critic objective.

text.tspan: PlaNet: optimize actions online. Dreamer: train an actor in imagination.
Original PlaNet uses Gaussian stochastic latents. This contrasts with the categorical DreamerV3 state shown above. The planner
is CEM in a receding-horizon loop; it is not Dreamer’s actor–critic objective.
